plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2024-2025 American International College 'Program Plan' for Criminal Justice (School of Business, Arts and Sciences). Semester totals printed on the plan: 15+16+15+15+15+14+15+15 = 120 credits. The program plan PDF does not print a degree abbreviation; recorded as BS per the program's published degree designation. Catalog substitutions: CRJ2350 Criminal Justice Research may be substituted with PSY3615 Experimental Psychology or SOC2631 Sociological Research Methods; CRJ3842 Criminology may be substituted with SOC2400 or SOC2410; CRJ4979 Criminal Justice Practicum requires a minimum of 3 credits and may be repeated up to 9 credits total. The two CRJ2xxx slots: choose two from CRJ2000 Report Writing in Criminal Justice, CRJ2295 Substance Abuse Issues in Criminal Justice, CRJ2421 The Juvenile Justice System, CRJ2426 Probation and Parole, CRJ2434 Administration and Management in Criminal Justice, CRJ2600 Principles of Personal and Physical Security. The two CRJ3xxx slots: choose two from CRJ3240 Criminal Procedures, CRJ3331 Terrorism, CRJ3520 Criminal Investigation, CRJ3530 Victimology, CRJ3636 Community Relations and the Criminal Justice System, CRJ3641 Comparative Criminal Justice Systems. The CRJxxxx slot: one additional CRJ elective from either list. General Education categories per the 2024-2025 plan: Cat 1 Scientific World (math + science with lab), Cat 2 Self and Others, Cat 3 Interdisciplinarity (ENG1202 + INT courses), Cat 4 Arts and Humanities, Cat 5 Professional Readiness (AIC1005/AIC1100 + AIC3005). tccns mirrors the local course code (AIC is in Massachusetts; no TCCNS). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
